answer.rationale: Negotiate with the incumbent before expiry, using market benchmarking and a multi-year volume commitment to pursue the mandated cost reduction while preserving integration stability and delivery continuity. The 94% line loading and lack of buffer make switching or relying on a new sole source too risky this cycle. Confirm negotiated savings and service protections before committing; retain delivery-risk uncertainty because the cost target may not be fully achievable through negotiation alone.
